## About Me

I'm a **Data Analyst at iLogitek Business Solutions, Bengaluru**. I build clean, reliable dashboards and reports that help teams make better decisions.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Focus** | Dashboards, data cleaning, KPI reporting, business insights |
| **Strengths** | Data validation, data modeling, stakeholder-ready reporting |
| **Currently learning** | Advanced DAX, Advanced SQL, BigQuery |
| **Location** | Bengaluru, India |
